_comment: Diversity / demand factors. Source: IET On-Site Guide (BS 7671:2018+A2) Appendix A, allowances-for-diversity table (NEC Article 220 for US projects). BS 7671 itself gives no diversity table - its Appendix 1 is the list of referenced standards, which this file previously cited in error. The OSG allowances are rules of the form '100% of the largest + x% of the remainder'; the single blanket factor per category below is a STING approximation of those rules for a commercial building, not an OSG value. Applied at panel rollup to convert connected load (the audit feeds kVA) to maximum demand. Override per project by editing this file or providing _BIM_COORD/diversity_factors.json.
_standard: IET On-Site Guide Appendix A / NEC 220

factors.comment: IET OSG App A: shops/offices 90% of total lighting demand; dwellings 66%
IET OSG App A (shops/offices): 100% of largest circuit + 75% of remainder; 0.75 blanket approximates
IET OSG App A (dwellings): first 10 A + 30% of remainder + 5 A if socket; 0.45 blanket approximates
IET OSG App A (shops/offices): 100% of largest + 75% of remainder
Diversity for starting kVA + duty cycle
BS 7671 §722 — no diversity unless smart charging
IET OSG App A treats motors as 100% of largest + a % of remainder; 1.00 is the conservative blanket, engineer adjusts

_neutral_comment: Triplen-harmonic content per load type. Neutral derating per BS 7671 §523.6.3 + IEEE 519. Three-phase neutral current can equal phase current when triplens exceed ~33% — neutral must be sized full or oversized.

harmonics.comment: LED drivers: 15-25% typical; older fluorescent magnetic: 30%+
Mixed IT + small loads via switching PSUs
Switching PSUs without PFC — significant triplens

_pfc_comment: Capacitor kVAR is computed, not looked up: Q = P x (tan(acos(PF_present)) - tan(acos(PF_target))). The kvarPerKwAtPf table that used to live here was wrong at every entry (0.85 -> 0.31; tan(acos 0.85) = 0.620) and has been removed. targetPfLagging is a project choice - set it to the local utility's reactive-power threshold (e.g. the UMEME tariff for Uganda). presentPfBaseline is an ASSUMPTION used only when no measured PF is supplied, and the audit says so.
_spare_comment: Spare-capacity targets per IEC 60364-5-52 Annex B + CIBSE Guide K (typical commercial 25%, industrial 30%, residential 20%, healthcare 35%).
